title: psbt-spec attribute command v1 (psbt-spec.attribute/1)
description: One JSON object per line. The caller writes hello_request and request lines to `psbt-spec attribute` on stdin; it writes one hello_response, result or error line to stdout for each, in order. See docs/attribute.md.

id.description: Optional, chosen by the caller and echoed. Any JSON string or integer.

base64.description: A PSBT in standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding.

spec.description: The psbt-spec revision that attributes, for the caller's records (principle 24).

bips.description: As in the adapter contract. 174 and 370 are accepted and do not gate (the reference reads the version from the PSBT); 372, 375 and 376 enable their rules; 322, 353, 371 and 373 are always checked. Any other number is an error.

psbt.description: The PSBT the role was given. Required for deserialize, construct, sign, finalize and extract.

sources.description: combine only, required: the PSBTs the Combiner was given.

returned.description: The PSBT the role returned. Required for create, construct and combine; optional for sign and finalize (absent: Preconditions only); not allowed for deserialize and extract.

delegates_additions.description: create only, required: the Creator hands the PSBT to others to add inputs or outputs (ROLE-C-2).

intended_timelocks.description: construct only, optional: for inputs the Constructor added, by index in the returned PSBT, whether the chosen spend branch needs a locktime (ROLE-C-4). Absent: ROLE-C-4 is Incomplete.

failed.description: Rules reported Failed, in evaluation order without repeats.

incomplete.description: Rules reported Incomplete and not Failed anywhere, in evaluation order. Never a violation (principle 14).

error.description: Why the request could not be attributed: malformed JSON, a missing or forbidden field, bad base64, an unknown BIP.
